mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `file` ( file_code, tenant_id, scope, creator_user_id, file_name, origin_name, file_suffix, content_type, file_size, storage_type, storage_path, file_hash, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{fileCode}, #{tenantId}, #{scope}, #{creatorUserId}, #{fileName}, #{originName}, #{fileSuffix}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{storageType}, #{storagePath}, #{fileHash}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE `file` SET file_code = #{fileCode}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, scope = #{scope}, creator_user_id = #{creatorUserId}, file_name = #{fileName}, origin_name = #{originName}, file_suffix = #{fileSuffix}, content_type = #{contentType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, storage_type = #{storageType}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, file_hash = #{fileHash}, status = #{status}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_code, tenant_id, creator_user_id, file_name, origin_name, file_suffix, scope, content_type, file_size, storage_type, storage_path, file_hash, status, created_at, updated_at FROM `file` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, file_code, tenant_id, creator_user_id, file_name, origin_name, file_suffix, scope, content_type, file_size, storage_type, storage_path, file_hash, status, created_at, updated_at FROM `file` WHERE file_code = #{fileCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, file_code, tenant_id, creator_user_id, file_name, origin_name, file_suffix, scope, content_type, file_size, storage_type, storage_path, file_hash, status, created_at, updated_at FROM `file` WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id DESC
